parts.label: USB
parts.func: USB-B to the ATmega32U2 USB-serial bridge (U1).

parts.label: X MOTOR
parts.func: Stepper output of driver U5 (X). Marlin X_STEP 37 / X_DIR 48 / X_ENABLE 29.
parts.machine: Pick-and-place X axis: twin lead screws, 8 mm lead.

parts.label: Y MOTOR
parts.func: Stepper output of driver U6 (Y). Marlin Y_STEP 36 / Y_DIR 49 / Y_ENABLE 28.
parts.machine: Pick-and-place Y axis: toolhead carriage, 20T GT2 belt (40 mm/rev).

parts.label: Z MOTOR 1
parts.func: Stepper output of driver U7 (Z). Marlin Z_STEP 35 / Z_DIR 47 / Z_ENABLE 27.
parts.machine: Pick-and-place Z axis: Z1/Z2 belt, 20T GT2 (40 mm/rev).

parts.label: E0 MOTOR
parts.func: Stepper output of driver U8 (E0). Marlin E0_STEP 34 / E0_DIR 43 / E0_ENABLE 26.

parts.label: E1 MOTOR
parts.func: Stepper output of driver U9 (E1). Marlin E1_STEP 33 / E1_DIR 42 / E1_ENABLE 25.
parts.machine: The project firmware drives a separate W axis from this socket; what it is wired to is unconfirmed.

parts.label: Y-MAX
parts.func: Endstop input, Marlin Y_MAX_PIN 23 (also SERVO1 on MX2).

parts.label: X-MAX
parts.func: Endstop input, Marlin X_MAX_PIN 24 (also SERVO2 on MX3).

parts.label: Power input
parts.func: Three 12-24 V inputs: motors/logic (via F2), heaters & fans (via F3), bed (via F4).

parts.label: MX2
parts.func: Motor-extension header 2 (SERVO1_PIN 23). Fitted as one 2x5 header (2213S-10G) spanning MX2 (X31) and MX3 (X32).

parts.label: MX3
parts.func: Motor-extension header 3 (SERVO2_PIN 24). Fitted as one 2x5 header (2213S-10G) spanning MX2 (X31) and MX3 (X32).

parts.label: Z MOTOR 2
parts.func: Wired in parallel with Z MOTOR 1 (same nets, same driver U7).

parts.label: Heat 0 / Fan 0 / Heat 1 / Fan 1 / Heat2-Bed
parts.func: Switched 12 V outputs, pairs left to right: Heat 0 (HEATER_0 pin 9), Fan 0 (FAN0 pin 8), Heat 1 (HEATER_1 pin 7), Fan 1 (FAN1 / HEATER_2 pin 6), Heat2-Bed (HEATER_BED pin 3).
